states.label: I can do this confidently and explain it

items.prompt: I can formulate an information need before choosing a search or AI tool.
items.recommended_action: State the question, required evidence and acceptable source types before searching.

items.prompt: I compare source quality, date, authorship and evidence before relying on online information.
items.recommended_action: Use a repeatable source-check routine on consequential claims.

items.prompt: I can organise files and data so that I can find the current version later.
items.recommended_action: Adopt simple naming, versioning and folder rules.

items.prompt: I can interpret basic tables and charts without confusing correlation with proof.
items.recommended_action: Identify population, period, units and what the data does not establish.

items.prompt: When AI gives factual information, I know when and how to verify it.
items.recommended_action: Verify consequential AI claims against primary or authoritative sources.

items.prompt: I choose communication channels according to sensitivity, urgency and audience.
items.recommended_action: Check recipient, channel and sharing permissions before sending sensitive material.

items.prompt: I can collaborate on shared documents without losing track of versions or ownership.
items.recommended_action: Use version history and clear edit/review responsibilities.

items.prompt: I manage what my digital profiles reveal and who can access shared information.
items.recommended_action: Review profile visibility, old sharing links and permissions.

items.prompt: I recognise when identity, tone or context may be ambiguous in digital communication.
items.recommended_action: Verify unusual or consequential requests through another channel.

items.prompt: I review AI-assisted messages before sending them as if they were my own.
items.recommended_action: Check facts, tone, confidential information and unintended claims.

items.prompt: I can create and edit digital content in formats appropriate to purpose and audience.
items.recommended_action: Practise presenting the same information in two suitable formats.

items.prompt: I consider copyright, licensing and attribution before reusing digital material.
items.recommended_action: Check reuse rights and record the source before publishing.

items.prompt: I can make common documents reasonably accessible to different users.
items.recommended_action: Use meaningful headings, readable structure and alternative text where needed.

items.prompt: I can use simple automation or reusable templates without losing control of the result.
items.recommended_action: Automate one repeatable task and define what still needs human checking.

items.prompt: I can recognise and correct factual or structural errors in AI-generated content.
items.recommended_action: Treat AI output as a draft and validate important claims before reuse.

items.prompt: I protect important accounts with appropriate authentication and recovery settings.
items.recommended_action: Review the authentication, recovery channels and active sessions of your primary email account.

items.prompt: I keep devices and apps updated and know when a device is no longer supported.
items.recommended_action: Enable automatic updates where suitable and identify unsupported devices.

items.prompt: I understand what personal or sensitive data I share with apps and services.
items.recommended_action: Review permissions and remove access that is not needed.

items.prompt: I recognise when digital use harms concentration, wellbeing or healthy boundaries.
items.recommended_action: Set one concrete boundary for notifications, focus time or device use.

items.prompt: Before giving data to an AI service, I consider confidentiality, privacy and necessity.
items.recommended_action: Avoid entering sensitive data unless service, purpose and permissions justify it.

items.prompt: I can describe a digital problem clearly before trying random fixes.
items.recommended_action: Record the symptom, expected behaviour, recent change and exact error.

items.prompt: I choose digital tools based on requirements rather than popularity alone.
items.recommended_action: Compare candidate tools against security, portability, cost and task requirements.

items.prompt: I can learn a new digital tool using documentation, examples and controlled experimentation.
items.recommended_action: Learn one unfamiliar function from primary documentation.

items.prompt: I know when a digital task exceeds my competence or authority and I should seek help.
items.recommended_action: Define stop conditions for security, legal, financial or irreversible actions.

items.prompt: I can use AI to explore options while keeping responsibility for the final decision and verification.
items.recommended_action: Separate AI suggestions from evidence and the decision you personally accept.
